name: Battle of Karbala
summary: Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of Muhammad, refuses to pledge loyalty to Umayyad Caliph Yazid I and marches toward Kufa with 72 followers to lead a revolt. He is intercepted at Karbala and massacred with his companions on the 10th of Muharram. His death creates the foundational trauma of Shia Islam, observed as Ashura, and permanently establishes the Sunni-Shia schism.

_quarry.structural_significance: The single most divisive moment in Islamic history; Husayn's martyrdom at Karbala becomes the defining narrative of Shia identity, shaping Islamic civilization for 1,400 years.
